content.text: {"subject":"Math","mode":"questions","extracted_questions":[{"question":"24 + 13 =","answer":"37","reasoning":"Add ones first (4+3=7), then tens (2+1=2), giving 37.","photo":0,"box":[168,352,660,403]},{"question":"45 − 18 =","answer":"27","reasoning":"Check by borrowing: 45-18, ones 5-8 needs borrow, 15-8=7, tens 3-1=2, so 27 not 33.","photo":0,"box":[168,481,660,533]},{"question":"56 + 27 =","answer":"83","reasoning":"Add ones 6+7=13, write 3 carry 1; tens 5+2+1=8, giving 83.","photo":0,"box":[168,610,660,662]},{"question":"90 − 42 =","answer":"48","reasoning":"90 minus 42: tens 9-4=5, ones 0-2 borrow gives 8, so 48 matches.","photo":0,"box":[168,739,660,791]},{"question":"7 × 8 =","answer":"56","reasoning":"7 times 8 from the multiplication table is 56, not 54 - ask Ishika to recount using 7x7=49+7.","photo":0,"box":[168,868,660,920]},{"question":"63 − 29 =","answer":"34","reasoning":"63 minus 29: ones 3-9 borrow, 13-9=4, tens 5-2=3, so 34.","photo":0,"box":[168,997,660,1049]},{"question":"15 + 38 =","answer":"53","reasoning":"Add ones 5+8=13, carry 1; tens 1+3+1=5, giving 53.","photo":0,"box":[168,1126,660,1178]},{"question":"72 ÷ 8 =","answer":"9","reasoning":"8 times 9 is 72, so the answer is 9, not 8 - ask her to check 8x8=64 vs 8x9=72.","photo":0,"box":[168,1255,660,1307]}],"concept_explanation":null,"aditiApplicable":false,"aditiHook":null}
